title: Introduction To Music In Primary School
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is derived from the French word for key - clef."
Clef in music is derived from the French word for key - clef.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to prolong a particular pitch before it by one beat or pulse."
A single dash is used to prolong a particular pitch before it by one beat or pulse.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those instruments that are held by the player and played directly."
Primary idiophones are those instruments that are held by the player and played directly.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the loudness or softness of a musical sound."
Volume is the loudness or softness of a musical sound.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the indigenous music of any given people or culture."
Traditional music is the indigenous music of any given people or culture.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered along the four voice parts - soprano, alto, tenor, and bass."
Chord progression is considered along the four voice parts - soprano, alto, tenor, and bass.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the highness or lowness of sound."
Pitch refers to the highness or lowness of sound.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sounding together of two or more notes."
A chord is the sounding together of two or more notes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to restore or readjust a flattened or sharpened note (whether single or double) to its original or basic pitch."
The natural sign is used to restore or readjust a flattened or sharpened note (whether single or double) to its original or basic pitch.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a product of how the different parts or sections of the complete melody (and therefore the music) are put together."
Form is a product of how the different parts or sections of the complete melody (and therefore the music) are put together.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the areas where humans are different from one another."
The voice is one of the areas where humans are different from one another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of such platforms that encourage collective involvement of the people."
A traditional festival is one of such platforms that encourage collective involvement of the people.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of a series of black and white keys."
The keyboard is made up of a series of black and white keys.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to describe the note on which a scale is built."
Tonic is used to describe the note on which a scale is built.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are referred to as primary triads, while the others, especially the minor triads, are called secondary triads."
The major triads are referred to as primary triads, while the others, especially the minor triads, are called secondary triads.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the dynamics of pitch, which consist in the various notes or tones within a given scale or key."
Intonation refers to the dynamics of pitch, which consist in the various notes or tones within a given scale or key.
fib: ______ are used predominantly in music - major and minor scales.
Two types of scales
Two types of scales are used predominantly in music - major and minor scales.
______ is the combination of two or more sounds; they are to be heard together or at the same time.
Harmony
Harmony is the combination of two or more sounds; they are to be heard together or at the same time.
______ is the music practised by the various peoples of Africa before the incursions of external cultures, colonialism or any Western-imposed traditions.
Traditional African music
Traditional African music is the music practised by the various peoples of Africa before the incursions of external cultures, colonialism or any Western-imposed traditions.
______ is a set of letters, which are derived from the first seven letters of the English alphabet.
music alphabet
The music alphabet is a set of letters, which are derived from the first seven letters of the English alphabet.
______ are used to aid the interpretation of music notes or sounds, which depict when sounds are produced through to when they are not heard.
Time names
Time names are used to aid the interpretation of music notes or sounds, which depict when sounds are produced through to when they are not heard.
______ is made up of five lines and four spaces.
staff
A staff is made up of five lines and four spaces.
______ is a very common scale type that is used in many cultures of the world.
Pentatonic scale
Pentatonic scale is a very common scale type that is used in many cultures of the world.
______ is the distance in pitch between one note and another.
interval
An interval is the distance in pitch between one note and another.
______ is a vital means of self-expression.
Music
Music is a vital means of self-expression.
______ is the lowest note is said to be in root position.
triad whose root
A triad whose root is the lowest note is said to be in root position.
______ is a series or sequence of notes or pitches.
scale
A scale is a series or sequence of notes or pitches.
______ is the grouping of beats into recurring successive patterns.
measure or bar
A measure or bar is the grouping of beats into recurring successive patterns.
______ is a source of music, especially the voice.
human body
The human body is a source of music, especially the voice.
______ is a term used to describe the distance that exists between the highest and the lowest pitches of a given melody.
Range
Range is a term used to describe the distance that exists between the highest and the lowest pitches of a given melody.
______ are known by some local or indigenous names, like the other instruments.
Drums
Drums are known by some local or indigenous names, like the other instruments.
______ are considered horizontally, which means that two notes of an interval are heard one after the other.
Melodic intervals
Melodic intervals are considered horizontally, which means that two notes of an interval are heard one after the other.
